library.description: Native RDF and SPARQL protocol storage backend

blocks.text: 把 RDF 数据写入远程 SPARQL 端点或本地 Oxigraph，并用查询链读取、筛选和修改四元组，也就是包含主语、谓词、对象和图的数据。选择 HTTP 或 Oxigraph 适配后安装插件，应用可用 RDF 值构造查询，并通过 `expect` 声明提交时必须仍存在的四元组；网络写入结果未知时不会自动重试。

items: 拼接查询遇到引号就坏掉，把数据当作 SPARQL 语法插入。
两个请求都读到旧值后分别改名，误以为同一谓词天然只有一个值。
HTTP 写入超时后重试，第一次其实已经提交。
导入多个 RDF 文档后 blank node 混在一起，忽略了其文档内身份。
`term` 与模板绑定区分 RDF 数据和查询语法，见HTTP 读写。
`expect` 显式声明读到的四元组，让条件提交检测真实竞争，见检测并发修改。
图文档使用真实 RDF parser/writer，跨文档 blank node 分别命名，见图文档与本体。
结果未知的写入不会自动重放；原生拒绝、读取失败与提交未知分别报告，见失败与释放。

blocks.text: 下面使用真实 Oxigraph Store，写一条姓名四元组，再按主语读回数量。

blocks.code:
import { Store } from 'oxigraph'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { rdf } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { term } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sparqlBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql'
import { oxigraphEndpoint } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql/oxigraph'

await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint: oxigraphEndpoint(new Store()) })]
})
const store = host.backend('sparql')
const quad = {
  subject: term.iri('urn:example:alice'),
  predicate: term.iri('urn:example:name'),
  object: term.literal('Alice'),
  graph: term.defaultGraph
}
await store.use(rdf).add([quad])
console.log(await store.use(rdf).match({ subject: quad.subject }).count())

blocks.text: 预期输出：
需要筛选和删除看查询与修改四元组，需要远程服务看HTTP 读写。
直接拼文本和发送 HTTP 还要自己处理数据转义和提交确认。这里只展示，不执行。
模板参数绑定 RDF term；事务通过条件更新和提交确认区分真实冲突与未知结果。

rows: 真实数据库的 query/update 连接，可由 HTTP 或 Oxigraph 适配。
处理应用可直接比较的四元组。
带 term 绑定的原生 SELECT、ASK、CONSTRUCT、UPDATE。
累积修改，在一次条件提交中检查前提。
导入、导出或替换单个图的 RDF 文档。

blocks.text: raw SPARQL 是直接表达原生查询语句的模板。四元组包含主语、谓语、宾语和图。ground quad 指不含 blank node 或变量的可稳定命名四元组。组织视图把逻辑图映射到各自的真实命名图。

rows: 修改前确认旧值仍存在

blocks.text: 当前包为 `private: true`，用于本仓库 workspace，不能假定 registry 已发布。从同一 workspace 的应用目录安装相邻包及真实 peers：

blocks.code:
pnpm add --workspace @migaia/storage-host @migaia/storage-contract @migaia/storage-plugin-sparql
pnpm add n3@^1.26.0 oxigraph@^0.4.11

blocks.text: 需要 Node.js 24 或更新版本。根入口不加载 Oxigraph 原生运行代码；`/oxigraph` 显式选择真实 Store，`/http` 使用运行时 fetch。RDF 解析使用 n3，声明来自真实 RDF/JS 依赖。

rows: 安装一个端点，id 默认 sparql。

blocks.text: 提供 RDF、SPARQL 和原生乐观事务，不提供 KV、records、vector、SQL 或键锁。标准 RDF 仅接受命名主语/谓语、命名或字面量宾语、缺省或命名图。raw SELECT/CONSTRUCT 和文档另支持 blank node；RDF-star、文档变量与标准 blank quad 拒绝。推理由数据库承担。
endpoint 与 Store 由调用方管理，host 不关闭它们。Oxigraph 0.4.11 的公开 Store 类型没有 close/dispose 方法，无需编造一个；远程连接池的释放遵循调用方客户端 API。host 关闭拒绝新调用、取消活动读取并等待已发提交。
没有 `expect` 时只保证规范四元组的集合成员修改；不同宾语可同时存在，不提供谓词单值覆盖。HTTP 部署须保证单条条件 Modify 原子执行和同 dataset 的写后读可见性，协议本身不能证明这一点。原生错误域、提交未知和图文档边界见使用指南。

rows: 使用远程 SPARQL 服务

blocks.text: 此例写入两条姓名，再只删除 Alice。

blocks.code:
import { Store } from 'oxigraph'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { rdf } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { term } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sparqlBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql'
import { oxigraphEndpoint } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql/oxigraph'

await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint: oxigraphEndpoint(new Store()) })]
})
const store = host.backend('sparql')
const quad = {
  subject: term.iri('urn:example:alice'),
  predicate: term.iri('urn:example:name'),
  object: term.literal('Alice'),
  graph: term.defaultGraph
}
await store
  .use(rdf)
  .add([quad, { ...quad, subject: term.iri('urn:example:bob'), object: term.literal('Bob') }])
const selected = store
  .use(rdf)
  .match({ predicate: quad.predicate })
  .where((value) => value.object.value === 'Alice')
console.log(await selected.count())
console.log(await selected.delete())
console.log(await store.use(rdf).match({}).count())

blocks.text: 预期输出：
quad 的 subject/predicate 用命名节点，object 用命名节点或字面量，graph 用缺省图或命名节点。`term.literal` 支持 language 或 datatype；term 绑定负责转义。标准 API 不接受 blank node 或变量。
`match(pattern)` 的 pattern 是 quad 字段子集。查询链支持 where、follow/inverse、orderBy、distinct、skip、limit、分页、聚合和 stream。`explain()` 区分原生步骤与客户端步骤；`requirePushdown()` 对不支持的客户端步骤在请求前拒绝。
`delete` 对实际选中、接受修改的规范 quad 去重计数；`replace(old, new)` 仅替换选中的 old，未选中返回 0。根调用等提交确认后才返回；事务内数量描述当前修改草稿。
先声明 Alice 仍存在，再把它改为 Ada。若另一个事务移除了 Alice，这次提交会冲突。

blocks.code:
import { Store } from 'oxigraph'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { rdf } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { ConcurrencyPolicy } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { term } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sparqlBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql'
import { oxigraphEndpoint } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql/oxigraph'

await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint: oxigraphEndpoint(new Store()) })]
})
const store = host.backend('sparql')
const quad = {
  subject: term.iri('urn:example:alice'),
  predicate: term.iri('urn:example:name'),
  object: term.literal('Alice'),
  graph: term.defaultGraph
}
await store.use(rdf).add([quad])
await store
  .tx()
  .concurrency(ConcurrencyPolicy.optimistic({ retries: 1 }))
  .run(async (scope) => {
    scope.use(rdf).expect([quad])
    await scope.use(rdf).delete([quad])
    await scope.use(rdf).add([{ ...quad, object: term.literal('Ada') }])
  })
console.log((await store.use(rdf).match({}).all()).map((value) => value.object.value).join(','))

blocks.text: 预期输出：

blocks.code: Ada

blocks.text: `expect` 条件按合取检查；`expectAbsent` 要求各 quad 不存在。草稿按规范 quad 身份去重，同一 quad 最后成员操作生效。未声明前提的读取不会自动成为读集；两个事务分别插入不同宾语时可同时保留，不提供谓词单值覆盖。
`ConcurrencyPolicy.optimistic({retries: 1})` 最多重试一次真实冲突；callback 可能重新执行，外部副作用应放在事务成功之后。backoffMs 默认 20；省略策略时不自动启用乐观重试。只支持乐观并发，不支持键锁、wait/fail 策略或交互式远程事务。
一次条件 DELETE/INSERT WHERE 同时写用户数据和提交 marker，随后 ASK 确认，再清理 marker。只有 Update 成功且 ASK 明确 marker 不存在才是可重试的冲突。已发送 Update 结果未知、ASK 失败或取消为 SPARQL_COMMIT_UNKNOWN；停止该后端后续写入，不重放。清理 marker 失败只 report，用户数据已提交。
有 atomicUpdate 的端点才可在事务内执行一个 raw update body，不能混 RDF 操作/前提或第二个 raw body。Oxigraph 提供一次原生 Store.update；httpEndpoint 不提供此能力，在写入前拒绝。raw 事务模板只提供 update，不提供 select/ask/construct。

先运行支持 SPARQL Query 与 Update 的真实服务。示例默认连接本机 3030 端口的 `storage` dataset；地址不同时，设置 `SPARQL_QUERY_URL`、`SPARQL_UPDATE_URL` 和 `SPARQL_GRAPH_STORE_URL`，三者应指向同一 dataset。Graph Store URL 供图文档操作使用。此例先插入再 ASK，写入的数据会留在服务中。
预期输出：

blocks.code: true

blocks.text: queryUrl/updateUrl 必填，graphStoreUrl 仅图文档功能需要。URL 为不含内嵌凭据的绝对 HTTP(S)。可选 auth 精确选择 `{basic: {user, password}}` 或 `{bearer}`。修改请求一次发送，不跟随重定向；读取沿 fetch 行为。Graph Store HEAD404 返回 false，GET404 拒绝。认证头不进入诊断数据。
根 raw tag 支持 select、ask、construct、update。普通字符串是数据，不应作为语法插入；用 term 绑定 RDF 参数。raw SELECT/CONSTRUCT 支持结果内 blank node，标识仅限同一响应。
部署须保证单条条件 Modify 原子执行、同 dataset 写后读可见。已覆盖 Fuseki 6.2.0、Oxigraph 0.4.11 的原生路径，其他部署需确认等价保证；HTTP 协议不等于数据库事务。
写入一个图，导出后按 replace 再导入；所有操作都来自本例安装的 Feature。

true
true
1

blocks.text: target 精确选择 `{default: true}` 或 `{graph: namedNode}`。document 的 format 是 text/turtle 或 application/n-triples，text 是完整文档。get/export 默认 Turtle。Graph Store 提供 getGraph、putGraph、mergeGraph、removeGraph、hasGraph；ontology 提供 importOntology/exportOntology。import mode 默认 merge，replace 替换真实单图；返回解析条数，含重复，不是新增数。
n3 处理 RDF1.1 文档语法。同一文档的 blank node 共享身份，不同导入重新命名。拒绝 RDF-star 和文档变量，不执行推理。端点须实际提供 graphStore；Feature 方法在 store.api；组织视图仍按自身图映射执行，事务内没有图文档 API。
`host.org(id).backend('sparql')` 将 default/named 逻辑图映射到 `urn:migaia:org:<orgId>:` 下的真实命名图。不同组织隔离；dropOrg 删除目标组织全部物理图，包括空命名图与含 blank node 的文档。raw SPARQL 只允许配置的默认组织。
标准 RDF、图文档和 ontology 禁止操作 `urn:migaia:commit` 保留图。进程崩溃可能留下 marker；管理员确认没有活动提交后才可在数据库执行 `CLEAR SILENT GRAPH <urn:migaia:commit>`。绕过标准 API 修改该图会破坏提交确认。

错误 source 为 storage.backend.sparql。SPARQL_REQUEST_FAILED 是原生明确拒绝，保留 status/body/cause；SPARQL_UNAVAILABLE 是读取 transport/5xx 失败；SPARQL_RESPONSE_INVALID 是非法结果/文档；SPARQL_COMMIT_UNKNOWN 是写结果无法确认，须先核实 dataset，再创建新的后端。callback、草稿任务和 finalizer 的业务失败使用 TRANSACTION_FAILED，原生类型、primary 和原因链保留；已有 contract/协议错误不改身份。

host 默认检测；autoDetect:false 时先 await host.detect()。关闭拒绝新调用，取消活动读取，等待已发提交。dispose() 的主 Promise 保留清理失败；Symbol.asyncDispose 共享清理并只 report。endpoint、Oxigraph Store 与自备客户端由调用方管理，不由插件关闭。Oxigraph 0.4.11 无公开 close/dispose 方法。
hooks 只观察，失败交给 report；干预使用 host pipeline。HTTP 观察不含认证或正文。查询成本包含真实结果字节和客户端剩余操作；图文档整体解析和传输，事务条件文本随 quad/前提数量增长，不承诺数据库计划或推理性能。

Write RDF to a remote SPARQL endpoint or local Oxigraph store and use query chains to read, filter and change quads: data made of a subject, predicate, object and graph. Install the plugin with an HTTP or Oxigraph adapter, construct queries from RDF values, and use `expect` to require specific quads to remain present at commit. A network write with an unknown outcome is not retried automatically.

items: A quote breaks a query because a value was inserted as SPARQL syntax.
Two requests rename the same subject after reading an old value, assuming a predicate can have only one value.
A timed-out HTTP write is retried even though it already committed.
Blank nodes from separate RDF documents become confused because their identities were treated as global.
Terms and template bindings separate RDF data from query syntax. See HTTP reads and writes.
`expect` states which quads must still exist for a conditional commit. See Detect competing updates.
Graph documents use a real RDF parser/writer, with separate blank-node identities for separate imports. See Graph documents and ontology.
Unknown writes are not replayed automatically. Explicit rejection, read failure and unknown commit have distinct errors. See Failures and disposal.

blocks.text: The module is currently `private: true` for this repository's workspace; do not assume a registry release. From an application in the same workspace, install the neighboring module and real peers:

blocks.code:
pnpm add --workspace @migaia/storage-host @migaia/storage-contract @migaia/storage-plugin-sparql
pnpm add n3@^1.26.0 oxigraph@^0.4.11

blocks.text: Use Node.js 24 or later. The root does not load Oxigraph's native runtime. `/oxigraph` explicitly selects a real Store; `/http` uses runtime fetch. RDF parsing uses n3 and real RDF/JS declarations.

rows: Install an endpoint; id defaults to sparql.

blocks.text: The backend supplies RDF, SPARQL and native optimistic transactions, with no KV, records, vector, SQL or key locks. Standard RDF accepts named subjects/predicates, named or literal objects, and default/named graphs. Raw SELECT/CONSTRUCT and documents also support blank nodes. RDF-star, document variables and blank standard quads reject. Reasoning belongs to the database.

The endpoint and Store remain with the caller; the host never closes them. Oxigraph 0.4.11's public Store type has no close/dispose method. Release any external connection pool through that client's real API. Host shutdown rejects new calls, cancels active reads and waits for dispatched commits.

Without expect, changes have canonical quad-set semantics: different objects may coexist for one predicate. HTTP deployment must guarantee atomic execution of a conditional Modify and read-after-write visibility on the same dataset; the protocol alone cannot establish those properties. See the usage guide for failures, unknown commits and document limits.

blocks.text: Expected output:

A quad uses named subject/predicate nodes, a named or literal object, and a default/named graph. term.literal accepts language or datatype. Term binding handles escaping. Standard RDF rejects blank nodes and variables.

match(pattern) accepts a subset of quad fields. Its query chain supports where, follow/inverse traversal, orderBy, distinct, skip, limit, pages, aggregates and stream. explain() distinguishes native from client steps; requirePushdown() rejects unsupported client steps before I/O.

delete counts deduplicated canonical quads actually selected and accepted for change. replace(old, new) changes only a selected old quad, returning 0 otherwise. Root calls wait for commit confirmation; counts inside a transaction describe its draft.
Require Alice to remain present before replacing it with Ada. If another transaction removed Alice, this commit conflicts.

blocks.text: expect conditions are conjunctions; expectAbsent requires each supplied quad to be absent. Draft changes deduplicate canonical quad identities with last-operation-wins for the same quad. Reads do not automatically form a read set. Concurrent insertions of different objects can both survive; predicates have no single-value guarantee.

ConcurrencyPolicy.optimistic({retries: 1}) retries one real conflict at most. The callback may run again, so perform external side effects after the transaction succeeds. backoffMs defaults to 20. Omitting the policy does not enable automatic optimistic retry. Only optimistic concurrency is supported, without key locks, wait/fail policies or interactive remote transactions.

One conditional DELETE/INSERT WHERE writes user quads and a commit marker, followed by ASK confirmation and marker cleanup. Only a successful Update followed by a successful ASK explicitly finding no marker is a retryable conflict. Unknown Update outcomes, failed ASK and cancellation during confirmation produce SPARQL_COMMIT_UNKNOWN. Later writes on that backend stop and are not replayed. Marker cleanup failures are reported after user data has committed.

A transaction may execute one raw update body only when its endpoint supplies atomicUpdate. It cannot mix RDF operations/preconditions or a second raw body. Oxigraph provides one native Store.update; httpEndpoint does not provide this capability and rejects before sending a write. Transaction raw templates expose update only, without select/ask/construct.

Start a real service that supports SPARQL Query and Update. The defaults use the `storage` dataset on local port 3030. For other addresses, set `SPARQL_QUERY_URL`, `SPARQL_UPDATE_URL` and `SPARQL_GRAPH_STORE_URL` to the same dataset; the Graph Store URL is used for graph document operations. This inserts data and reads it with ASK; the data remains in the service.

blocks.code: true

blocks.text: queryUrl/updateUrl are required; graphStoreUrl is needed only for graph-document features. URLs must be absolute HTTP(S) without embedded credentials. Optional auth is exactly `{basic: {user, password}}` or `{bearer}`. Mutations are sent once without redirect following. Reads retain fetch behavior. Graph Store HEAD404 returns false; GET404 rejects. Authentication headers are not diagnostic data.

The root raw tag supports select, ask, construct and update. A normal string is data, not syntax; bind RDF terms as template values. Raw SELECT/CONSTRUCT also support blank nodes scoped to one response.

Deployment must guarantee atomic execution of one conditional Modify and read-after-write visibility on the same dataset. Native paths cover Fuseki 6.2.0 and Oxigraph 0.4.11; other deployments must supply equivalent guarantees. An HTTP protocol is not itself a database transaction.

blocks.text: target selects exactly `{default: true}` or `{graph: namedNode}`. A document has format text/turtle or application/n-triples and complete document text. get/export default to Turtle. Graph Store offers getGraph, putGraph, mergeGraph, removeGraph and hasGraph. Ontology offers importOntology/exportOntology. Import mode defaults to merge; replace uses a real per-graph replacement. Its count is parsed statements including duplicates, not newly inserted statements.

n3 handles RDF1.1 syntax. Blank nodes share identity within a document and receive fresh identities across imports. RDF-star and document variables reject. No reasoning is performed. The endpoint must actually provide graphStore. Feature methods are on store.api; organization views retain their graph mapping. Transaction scopes have no graph-document API.

host.org(id).backend('sparql') maps logical default/named graphs into physical named graphs under `urn:migaia:org:<orgId>:`. Organizations remain separate. dropOrg removes all the target organization's graphs, including empty named graphs and blank-node documents. Raw SPARQL is available only in the configured default organization.

Standard RDF, graph documents and ontology reject the reserved `urn:migaia:commit` graph. A crash can leave markers. Only after confirming that no commits are active should an administrator run `CLEAR SILENT GRAPH <urn:migaia:commit>` directly in the database. Bypassing the standard API to change that graph breaks confirmation guarantees.

Error source is storage.backend.sparql. SPARQL_REQUEST_FAILED means explicit native rejection and retains status/body/cause. SPARQL_UNAVAILABLE means read transport/5xx failure. SPARQL_RESPONSE_INVALID means invalid results/documents. SPARQL_COMMIT_UNKNOWN requires checking the dataset before constructing a new backend. Callback, draft-task and finalizer business failures use TRANSACTION_FAILED while retaining native type, primary failure and cause chain. Existing contract/protocol errors keep their identities.

Hosts detect by default; with autoDetect:false, call await host.detect() first. Closing rejects new calls, cancels active reads and waits for dispatched commits. dispose() retains cleanup failures in its main Promise. Symbol.asyncDispose shares cleanup and reports failures. Endpoints, Oxigraph Stores and supplied clients remain with the caller, and the plugin never closes them. Oxigraph 0.4.11 has no public close/dispose method.

Hooks observe only and report failures; use the host pipeline for intervention. HTTP observations contain neither authentication nor bodies. Query cost includes actual result bytes and remaining client work. Graph documents are parsed/transferred as a whole; transaction condition text grows with quads/preconditions. No database-plan or inference performance claim is made.

symbols.signature: export declare function oxigraphEndpoint(store: Store): ISparqlEndpoint;
symbols.purpose: Use the borrowed Store native query, update, load and dump operations while preserving caller ownership.
symbols.core:
store: Real Oxigraph Store from the supported peer.
One endpoint with genuine one-body atomicUpdate and per-graph operations.
examples:
import { Store } from 'oxigraph'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { rdf } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { term } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sparqlBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql'
import { oxigraphEndpoint } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql/oxigraph'

await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint: oxigraphEndpoint(new Store()) })]
})
const store = host.backend('sparql')
const quad = {
  subject: term.iri('urn:example:alice'),
  predicate: term.iri('urn:example:name'),
  object: term.literal('Alice'),
  graph: term.defaultGraph
}
await store
  .use(rdf)
  .add([quad, { ...quad, subject: term.iri('urn:example:bob'), object: term.literal('Bob') }])
const selected = store
  .use(rdf)
  .match({ predicate: quad.predicate })
  .where((value) => value.object.value === 'Alice')

import { Store } from 'oxigraph'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-host'
import { rdf } from '@migaia/storage-contract'
import { ConcurrencyPolicy } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { term } from '@migaia/storage-host/sdk'
import { sparqlBackendPlugin } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql'
import { oxigraphEndpoint } from '@migaia/storage-plugin-sparql/oxigraph'

await using host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [sparqlBackendPlugin({ endpoint: oxigraphEndpoint(new Store()) })]
})
const store = host.backend('sparql')
const quad = {
  subject: term.iri('urn:example:alice'),
  predicate: term.iri('urn:example:name'),
  object: term.literal('Alice'),
  graph: term.defaultGraph
}
await store.use(rdf).add([quad])
await store
  .tx()
  .concurrency(ConcurrencyPolicy.optimistic({ retries: 1 }))
  .run(async (scope) => {
    scope.use(rdf).expect([quad])
    await scope.use(rdf).delete([quad])
    await scope.use(rdf).add([{ ...quad, object: term.literal('Ada') }])
  })
console.log((await store.use(rdf).match({}).all()).map((value) => value.object.value).join(','))
